definition: DVC (Data Version Control) versions large datasets and models alongside Git and defines reproducible ML pipelines.
details: Created by Dmitry Petrov and Ivan Shcheklein in 2017 (Iterative.ai); now part of lakeFS.

explainer.lead: How to install DVC, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.

quickstart.python:
# in a terminal:
#   dvc init
#   dvc add data/train.csv          # tracked by hash, stored outside Git
#   dvc remote add -d store s3://my-bucket/dvc
#   dvc push
import dvc.api

with dvc.api.open("data/train.csv", rev="v1.0") as f:
    print(f.readline())

explainer.inAi: Know exactly which data produced which model, and switch datasets with git checkout.
explainer.jsNote: DVC is a command-line tool with a Python API; there is no JavaScript package.
